title: Spec Fact References — Enforcement Schema
description: Defines spec_fact_refs enforcement rules for evidence declaration work items. spec_fact_refs is BLOCKING (mandatory hard gate) for all new PRODUCT_SOURCE, TEST, REQUIREMENT, READINESS, and RELEASE_GATE work items. An item may be exempt only if exception_classification is explicitly set.

exception_classification.description: Explicit exception classification. Required when spec_fact_refs is empty for a product work item. No silent bypass — all exceptions must be declared. schema_authority_available: use when XSD/DTD schema is the primary authority source (e.g. Gnumeric). Distinct from no_public_spec_available (no authority document at all).

spec_fact_ref.description: Reference to a verified spec fact. Format: FACT-<FORMAT>-<NUMBER>, e.g. FACT-FODS-001

spec_fact_refs_field.description: Array of verified spec fact IDs that back this work item. Must be populated for product work items OR exception_classification must be set.

enforcement_rule.description: For item_type in blocking_item_types: if spec_fact_refs is empty AND exception_classification is absent, the declaration is INVALID and must be rejected. This is not a warning. This is a hard gate.
enforcement_rule.migration_note: Items created before 2026-06-07 may use exception_classification=legacy_backfill during a 2-sprint grace period.

examples.comment: PASS: explicit exception for format without public spec
FAIL: spec_fact_refs empty, no exception_classification — BLOCKED
